name: GDPval
summary: OpenAI benchmark of real-world, economically valuable knowledge-work tasks across 44 occupations; a 220-task gold subset with files and rubrics is open on Hugging Face.
description: The full set has 1,320 tasks built from real work products by professionals averaging 14 years of experience, spanning 44 occupations in the top 9 sectors of U.S. GDP. Each task has a prompt plus reference files (spreadsheets, documents, etc.); the open gold subset (`openai/gdpval`, v2 with rubrics and gold deliverables) has 220 tasks. OpenAI offers an experimental automated grader at evals.openai.com; human expert comparison remains the recommended grading method. Some tasks contain NSFW or political content. The Hugging Face dataset card does not state a license.
